exposure: Subgroups of patients with complete placenta previa based on different hemostatic methods used during cesarean delivery
Hemostatic methods used during cesarean delivery
Complete placenta previa vs. no placenta previa
different hemostatic methods used during CD
outcome: Uterine vascular supply (pulsatility index and systolic/diastolic ratio)
cohort: 136 patients with complete placenta previa and 140 patients without complete placenta previa who underwent cesarean delivery between January 2016 and December 2018
finding: While ovarian function was not significantly different between the groups, patients with complete placenta previa had reduced endometrial thickness, lower uterine resistance index at 42 days postpartum, and delayed menstrual resumption compared to those without complete placenta previa.
